newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell sees Q4, charge, gain.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell sees Q4, charge, gain.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said Monday it expects a fourth quarter restructuring charge of about $74 million, or 34 cents a share, offset by a gain of $76 million, or 35 cents a share.
The gain relates to favorable settlements of prior years' income tax and insurance claims.

Rockwell also said in a statement it has set December 4 as the date for a shareholder meeting to vote on the tax-free reorganization of Rockwell and the proposed sale of its Aerospace and Defense businesses to Boeing Co.
Rockwell reiterated its goal to grow earnings per share by 15 percent annually.
Rockwell said it shareowners will own about three percent of Boeing stock after the sale and that Rockwell will be essentially debt free since Boeing will assume $2.2 billion of Rockwell debt.
